releaseNotes: On-launch auto-update check — every app start verifies you're on the latest version and guides you to install it, so you're never running stale
New-account sign-up no longer hangs on a loading screen — registration completes instantly every time
Android infinite-load fixed — the service worker is torn down on native, eliminating stale-shell hangs inside the WebView
Smoother Android cold start — the native splash hides the moment the app is ready instead of waiting on a fixed timer
Android hardware back button now closes the lyrics overlay, then the expanded player, navigates back, and exits from Home
Google sign-in now works on the Android app — the WebView user-agent is corrected so OAuth no longer rejects it as an embedded browser
The Android app installs with the real Sonora icon, not the default Capacitor one
Faster cover-art loading across the app — preconnect to the image CDN, priority loading for above-the-fold artwork, and no skeleton flash on cached images
Cloudflare Worker share routes are live — Discord, X, and WhatsApp rich embeds render with real artwork and track metadata
Share artwork proxy guarantees image delivery on every platform, bypassing CDN blocking
Discord Rich Presence shows 'Listening to Sonora' with a live progress bar — indistinguishable from Spotify's integration
Multi-artist Smart Playlist — search and blend any number of artists into one taste-ranked playlist
Artist Mixes for every artist — Spotify-style mixes generated on demand
Shared links open the exact song or playlist, even after signing in
Pages auto-load with zero flash — cross-mount caching eliminates skeleton stutter
Release channel stabilized to 'stable' for reliable auto-update detection across all installed versions
